nodes.responsibility: Provide standard command-line interface to validate, execute, and inspect task pipelines.

def load_pipeline_file(filepath: str) -> List[Task]:
    with open(filepath, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        raw = json.load(f)
    return [Task.from_dict(item) for item in raw]

def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="OmniLite Task Pipeline Runner")
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="subcommand", help="Commands")

    val_parser = subparsers.add_parser("validate", help="Validate pipeline DAG")
    val_parser.add_argument("--file", required=True, help="Path to pipeline JSON file")

    run_parser = subparsers.add_parser("run", help="Execute pipeline DAG")
    run_parser.add_argument("--file", required=True, help="Path to pipeline JSON file")
    run_parser.add_argument("--storage", default=None, help="Optional persistence path")

    status_parser = subparsers.add_parser("status", help="Show saved tasks state")
    status_parser.add_argument("--storage", required=True, help="Path to storage JSON file")

    args = parser.parse_args(argv if argv is not None else sys.argv[1:])
    if args.subcommand == "validate":
        tasks = load_pipeline_file(args.file)
        graph = DependencyGraph(tasks)
        batches = graph.get_execution_batches()
        print(f"Validation SUCCESS: {len(tasks)} tasks in {len(batches)} batches.")
        return 0
    elif args.subcommand == "run":
        tasks = load_pipeline_file(args.file)
        store = TaskStore(args.storage) if args.storage else None
        executor = PipelineExecutor(store=store)
        res = executor.run_pipeline(tasks)
        print(f"Execution finished: {res.succeeded}/{res.total_tasks} passed in {res.duration_ms:.1f}ms")
        return 0 if res.failed == 0 else 1
    elif args.subcommand == "status":
        store = TaskStore(args.storage)
        tasks = store.load_tasks()
        print(f"Loaded {len(tasks)} tasks from {args.storage}")
        for t in tasks:
            print(f" - [{t.status.value}] {t.id}: {t.name}")
        return 0
    else:
        parser.print_help()
        return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
invariants: MUST import models, storage, graph, and executor without re-declaring their classes.
Subcommands supported: 'run', 'validate', and 'status'.
CLI must print human-readable summary and return exit code 0 on success, 1 on failure.
acceptance_tests: main(['--help']) prints usage instructions and exits 0.

class TestModels(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_task_serialization(self):
        t = Task(id="1", name="test", command="echo hi")
        self.assertEqual(t.status, TaskStatus.PENDING)
        d = t.to_dict()
        self.assertEqual(d["status"], "PENDING")
        t2 = Task.from_dict(d)
        self.assertEqual(t, t2)

class TestStorage(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_save_and_load(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
            p = os.path.join(tmpdir, "tasks.json")
            store = TaskStore(p)
            self.assertEqual(store.load_tasks(), [])
            t = Task(id="t1", name="T1", command="echo test")
            store.save_tasks([t])
            loaded = store.load_tasks()
            self.assertEqual(len(loaded), 1)
            self.assertEqual(loaded[0].id, "t1")

class TestGraph(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_batches(self):
        t1 = Task(id="a", name="A", command="echo a")
        t2 = Task(id="b", name="B", command="echo b", depends_on=["a"])
        graph = DependencyGraph([t1, t2])
        batches = graph.get_execution_batches()
        self.assertEqual(len(batches), 2)
        self.assertEqual(batches[0][0].id, "a")
        self.assertEqual(batches[1][0].id, "b")

    def test_cycle(self):
        t1 = Task(id="a", name="A", command="echo a", depends_on=["b"])
        t2 = Task(id="b", name="B", command="echo b", depends_on=["a"])
        graph = DependencyGraph([t1, t2])
        self.assertTrue(graph.has_cycle())
        with self.assertRaises(CycleError):
            graph.get_execution_batches()

class TestExecutor(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_pipeline_execution(self):
        t1 = Task(id="a", name="A", command="echo 'hello world'")
        t2 = Task(id="b", name="B", command="echo 'task b'", depends_on=["a"])
        executor = PipelineExecutor()
        res = executor.run_pipeline([t1, t2])
        self.assertEqual(res.succeeded, 2)
        self.assertEqual(res.failed, 0)
        self.assertEqual(t1.status, TaskStatus.COMPLETED)
        self.assertEqual(t1.output, "hello world")

    def test_pipeline_failure_cascade(self):
        t1 = Task(id="fail", name="F", command="exit 1")
        t2 = Task(id="dep", name="D", command="echo ok", depends_on=["fail"])
        executor = PipelineExecutor()
        res = executor.run_pipeline([t1, t2])
        self.assertEqual(res.failed, 2)
        self.assertEqual(t1.status, TaskStatus.FAILED)
        self.assertEqual(t2.status, TaskStatus.FAILED)

    unittest.main()
